summary: role init fails if a directory with the role's name exists; --force creates the structure anyway, overwriting matching files.
questions: ansible-galaxy role init says the directory exists, what now?
How do I overwrite an existing role skeleton?

answer_card.title: Overwrite with role init --force
answer_card.answer_md:
If a directory with the role name already exists, `init` errors out. Add `--force` to create the subdirectories and files anyway; matching files get replaced.
```bash
ansible-galaxy role init --force role_name
```
